name: search_schema
description: Search database schema using embeddings to find relevant tables and columns for a natural language question. Returns a compact schema slice suitable for query planning.

question.description: Natural language question to search schema for

top_k.description: Number of top relevant tables to return

return_type.description: Relevant schema information including table names and column details

examples.description: Find tables related to revenue and country

safety_guidelines: Requires discover_schema to be run first
Uses vector embeddings for semantic matching
